events.description: Rachel Green says Rachel Green currently feels violated.
Monica Geller says Ross Geller, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, and Chandler Bing felt like they wanted to peel the skin off their bodies to have something else to do.
Ross Geller asks if it is currently ten o'clock.
Ross Geller says it currently feels like it is two o'clock.
Chandler Bing says Aurora is currently at the eight o'clock position.
Chandler Bing says Aurora is currently at the nine o'clock position.
Chandler Bing says Aurora is currently at the ten o'clock position.
Chandler Bing says Aurora is amazing and makes the women that Chandler Bing dreams about look like short, fat, bald men.
Monica Geller tells Chandler Bing to go over to Aurora.
Monica Geller says Aurora is not with anyone right now.
Chandler Bing asks what Chandler Bing's opening line to Aurora should be.
Chandler Bing says Aurora would hear Chandler Bing say "Excuse me" as his opening line.
Rachel Green says Aurora is a person.
Rachel Green says Chandler Bing can go talk to Aurora.
Chandler Bing says Aurora is out of Chandler Bing's league.
Chandler Bing asks Ross Geller to back Chandler Bing up.
Ross Geller says Chandler Bing could never get a woman like Aurora even in a million years.
Chandler Bing thanks Ross Geller.
Phoebe Buffay says Chandler Bing knows that people often see very beautiful women with really "nothing" guys.
Phoebe Buffay says Chandler Bing always sees very beautiful women with really "nothing" guys.
Phoebe Buffay says Chandler Bing could be one of those "nothing" guys who dates a beautiful woman.
Monica Geller says Chandler Bing could be one of those "nothing" guys who dates a beautiful woman like Aurora.
Chandler Bing asks Monica Geller if Monica Geller thinks Chandler Bing could approach Aurora.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing cannot believe Chandler Bing is even considering going over to Aurora.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing is currently very aware of Chandler Bing's tongue.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing is about to go over to Aurora.
Chandler Bing says the next word Chandler Bing will say is "Chandler."
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing's name is Chandler Bing.
Aurora says Chandler Bing already said that Chandler Bing's name is Chandler Bing.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing wants to say what Chandler Bing was about to say.
Chandler Bing asks Aurora if Aurora would like to go out with Chandler Bing sometime.
Chandler Bing thanks Aurora.
Everyone says Joey Tribbiani is in a play.
Everyone says they did not know Joey Tribbiani could dance.
Everyone says Joey Tribbiani danced in the play.
Everyone says Joey Tribbiani had a beard in the play.
Joey Tribbiani asks everyone what they thought of Joey Tribbiani's play.
Joey Tribbiani says the play was not that bad, was better than the thing Joey Tribbiani did with the trolls, and everyone got to see Joey Tribbiani's head.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani previously did a thing with the trolls.
Everyone says they saw Joey Tribbiani's head.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing is giving a card to Joey Tribbiani.
Chandler Bing says Aurora said yes to going out with Chandler Bing.
Chandler Bing says Aurora's name is Aurora and Aurora is Italian.
Chandler Bing says Aurora pronounces Chandler Bing's name as "Chand-lrr."
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing thinks Chandler Bing likes that pronunciation better.
Chandler Bing tells everyone to listen.
Chandler Bing says the usher gave Chandler Bing a card to give to Joey Tribbiani.
Rachel Green asks what the card is that the usher gave to Chandler Bing to give to Joey Tribbiani.
Joey Tribbiani says an agency left Joey Tribbiani its card.
Joey Tribbiani says the Estelle Leonard Talent Agency might want to sign Joey Tribbiani.
Phoebe Buffay says the signing decision would be based on Joey Tribbiani's play.
